status: P30 concept (2026-11-15): low-cost 30x30 aluminium profile chassis with SS400 laser-cut steel plates. Two drive wheels on vertical slide suspension (MISUMI D20 shafts + ball bushings + one spring each), four GL-65 casters bolted rigid. Separate variant; the Rev15 model in cad/layout.json is unchanged.
coordinates: mm; X right, Y forward, Z up, ground Z0. Heading clockwise from +Y (CAD Z rotation = -heading).

frame.section_status: Generic 3030 slot-8 section for display (mouth 8, cavity 16x5.8, core D6.8 = M8 tap drill). Actual supplier section, alloy and end-tap need verification.

plates.material_note: P30-3: SS400 laser-cut steel, flat (no bending, no welding); thinner than the P30-2 A5052 plates (8/3/5 t) for cost

caster.bolt: M6x8 into M6 tapped corner plate (SS400 6t, 6 mm thread)

bush.supply: Purchase MISUMI economy linear bushing, round flange single (LMF20 equivalent)
bush.mount: Flange on top of the carriage plate, body down through a D32.5 bore; 4x M5 from the counterbored flange into the tapped plate
bush.source: MISUMI STEP AP214 (SolidWorks 2016) downloaded 2026-11-15 + catalogue table dr20 D32 L42 H54 T8 PCD43 d5.5 d1 9 t5.1

spring.source: MISUMI CK68 catalogue values as used in Rev12-14 (layout.json suspension.drive)

shaft.price_seen: 2026-11-15 kr.misumi-ec.com, 1-4 pcs, VAT excl., ships day 2
shaft.source: MISUMI STEP AP214 downloaded 2026-11-15 (L124, 1-4 pcs 10,868 KRW ex VAT)

electronics.status: Battery, LCD and speaker from company STEP files. Controller, computer, drivers, power distribution are envelopes; DC/DC DDR-240B-24 is a size reservation.

sensors.camera_fov_note: Depth FOV H58.4 x V45.5 (cad/parts.json + Rev15 viewer). Optics x = the three front openings of the Astra STEP (lens barrel D13.3, centre lens D17, window 21.8x14.5) in the camera frame; which one is the depth camera is not identified, so all three are checked
sensors.camera_yaw_note: P30-3: outward yaw 15 -> 5 deg. At 15 deg the outer optic of the left camera saw the front-left TiM571 (7.9% of the image, nearest 29 mm); clear from 6 deg down. Combined horizontal view +-34.2 deg (was +-44.2); the LiDARs cover the sides

load_case.note: Same design mass as Rev15 (20 kg arm included). Simple static estimates only.
